documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Letter To Shareholders Under Regulation 36(1)(B) Of SEBI (LODR), 2015

analysis.summary: During the financial year 2025-26, Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited reported a revenue from operations of ₹24,299.30 Lakhs, representing an increase of 16.59% over the previous year, and a profit after tax of ₹4,579.92 Lakhs. Management highlighted strong growth across the Indian automotive sector, supported by demand for windshields and the introduction of mandatory air-conditioned cabins in Medium & Heavy Commercial Vehicles. The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹2.5 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. Furthermore, the company focused on operational efficiency, automation initiatives, green energy adoption, and resource conservation. Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited reported an operational revenue of ₹20,841.38 lakhs and a profit after tax of ₹3,598.22 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.

guidance.claim: The Indian economy is expected to grow over 7% in the upcoming year.
guidance.quote: The Indian economy is expected to grow over 7% in the upcoming year, mainly driven by strong public demand and resilient private consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that electric vehicle adoption is accelerating in three-wheelers, with traditional large OEMs outperforming new entrants.
demand_outlook.quote: Electric vehicle adoption is accelerating in three-wheelers, with traditional large OEMs outperforming new entrants and consolidating their positions.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive sector demonstrated resilience with overall vehicle sales showing year-on-year growth.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive sector demonstrated commendable resilience during FY 2024-25, with overall vehicle sales showing year-on-year growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The commercial vehicle segment faced volume declines primarily due to delays in infrastructure projects during the general election year.
demand_outlook.quote: However, the commercial vehicle segment faced headwinds, experiencing a decline in volumes primarily due to delays in infrastructure projects during the general election year, which affected the first nine months of the financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The final quarter indicated a market recovery with improving volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: Notably, the final quarter indicated a recovery, with improving volumes.

demand_outlook.claim: The 3-wheeler segment maintained its revival trajectory in domestic and export markets with higher volumes and EV shifts.
demand_outlook.quote: The 3-wheeler segment maintained its trajectory of revival in both domestic and export markets, reporting higher volumes compared to the previous year, and further advancing its shift towards electric vehicles.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry is expected to see significant growth in the 3-wheeler segment driven by electric vehicles, along with strong growth in commercial vehicles and the bus segment.
demand_outlook.quote: In the coming year, the industry is expected to see significant growth in the 3-wheeler segment, driven by the rise in electric vehicles.

demand_outlook.claim: The bus segment is likely to experience strong growth due to increased travel, fleet purchases, and public transport electrification.
demand_outlook.quote: The bus segment is likely to experience strong growth due to increased travel, fleet purchases, and the shift to electric vehicles in public transport.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved an investment of up to 3 crores in Murli Solar Energy Private Limited towards sourcing green power.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with sustainability goals, the Board has approved an investment of up to `3 crores, in Murli Solar Energy Private Limited (SPV of Sunsure Energy Pvt Limited) towards sourcing green power.

capex_expansion.claim: Strategic investments were made in advanced windshield preprocessing lines transitioning from manual to automated processes.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with the increasing demand for high-quality, large-format windshields, your Company has made strategic investments in advanced windshield preprocessing lines. The shift from manual to automated cutting and grinding processes has significantly enhanced product quality and reduced operational risk at the plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Production line layouts were restructured and storage facilities relocated outside the main plant area to optimize space for larger windshield production.
capex_expansion.quote: To accommodate the production of larger windshields, space optimization became a priority. The production line layout was accordingly restructured to minimize glass movement, thereby improving ergonomics and workflow efficiency. Additionally, storage facilities were relocated outside the main plant area, creating valuable space for the expansion of production lines.

margins_costs.claim: High inflationary impact from raw glass costs, rupee depreciation, high-cost imports, and raw material price increases were partly offset by price increases.
margins_costs.quote: The high inflationary impact from raw glass costs, the rupee depreciation against dollar, high-cost imports, cost increases by almost all raw material suppliers were partly offset with price increase.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹2.5 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 15, 2026, has recommended a Final Dividend of ₹2.5 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The total CSR expenditure for the financial year 2025-26 was ₹83 Lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: During FY 2025-26, we spent `83 Lakhs in various CSR initiatives, as outlined in Annexure 5 of this report.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an investment not exceeding ₹2.46 crore in Radiance MH Sunshine Two Private Limited for sourcing green power.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at its meeting held on May 16, 2025, approved a revised investment of not exceeding ₹2.46 Crore (earlier approved investment of ₹2.45 Crore) in Radiance MH Sunshine Two Private Limited (in place of Radiance MH Sunrise Thirteen Private Limited) towards sourcing of green power.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors recommended a dividend of INR 2 per equity share of face value INR 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Directors are pleased to recommend for approval of the Members a dividend of ` 2/- per equity share of the face value of ` 10/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.

risks_headwinds.claim: The commercial vehicle segment encountered challenges with declining volumes caused by infrastructure project delays during the general election period.
risks_headwinds.quote: The commercial vehicle segment encountered challenges, witnessing a decline in volumes attributable to delays in new infrastructure projects amid the general election period during the first nine months of the fiscal year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations from global financial market volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company is exposed to foreign exchange fluctuations arising from volatility in global financial markets, which may affect its financial performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Non-compliance with increasingly stringent environmental norms may result in liabilities and reputational damage.
risks_headwinds.quote: Non-compliance to increasing stringent regulatory environmental norms may result in liabilities and damage to reputation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces exposure to raw material and energy price volatility alongside potential supply chain disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company is exposed to volatility in raw material and energy prices, which can significantly impact production costs. In addition, any disruption or constraint in the raw material supply chain may adversely affect manufacturing operations.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to strengthen its market presence by supplying key customers and engaging with others following the introduction of air-conditioned cabins.
management_commitments.quote: We have started supplying one key customer and are in discussions with others, aiming to strengthen our market presence.

management_commitments.claim: The growth strategy focuses on increasing business with current customers, broadening value-added offerings in commercial vehicles, successfully executing new light commercial vehicle programs, and expanding further in the bus body market.
management_commitments.quote: Our growth strategy focuses on increasing business with current customers, broadening value-added offerings in commercial vehicles, successfully executing new light commercial vehicle programs, and expanding further in the bus body market.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand in the OEM segment focusing on 3-wheelers, trucks, LCVs, buses, and aftermarket categories.
management_commitments.quote: Your Company is strategically aligned with this shift, focusing on expanding in the OEM segment, particularly in 3-wheelers, trucks, Light Commercial Vehicles (“LCVs”), buses, and aftermarket categories.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to execute the power sourcing agreement with Radiance MH Sunshine Two Private Limited upon statutory completion.
management_commitments.quote: On completion of the statutory requirements, the Agreement will be executed by the Parties.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. K.S. Gopalakrishnan was appointed as the Managing Director of the Company for a period of three years with effect from May 5, 2024 up to May 4, 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The appointment of the Managing Director is for a period of three (3) years with effect from May 5, 2024 up to May 4, 2027.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
